summary.text: Mark S. Chang is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 32 in Anne Arundel County, in office since January 14, 2015, who is running for the Maryland State Senate in District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is not seeking re-election to the House, and his opponent is Justin Gallucci (R) for an open Senate seat.

paragraphs.text: Chang graduated from Glen Burnie High School and, according to Ballotpedia, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maryland, Baltimore County and a graduate degree from Loyola University.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as associate at Neovista Consulting.
He took office in the House of Delegates in 2015 as the successor to Mary Ann Love (D).
The Maryland General Assembly lists him as serving on the Appropriations Committee.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Appropriations Committee, House chair of the Spending Affordability Committee, and a member of the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.
